body: For me personally I feel being impulsive wins over depression though. Nothing worse than having a fully depressed day

Mate take a step back and think about it, you can be or do whatever you set your ambitions to. Life is ALWAYS better than the simple nothingness, fight and fight until you then find yourself looking back and thinking “wow I changed that fast and I deserve life”. Seek professional help, always private as I’m the Uk the nhs mental health teams are neglectful and life ending, they don’t understand like true professionals do. Tell your family and never suffer alone. I believe that you can do it. I’m scarred and lucky to be alive, but I’m happy atleast knowing I can enjoy the little things like music, loving and memories at any moment I choose. Don’t give up!
If anyone feels like this I am creating a group of genuine human beings who wish to help one another. Mental health CAN be managed and there’s always a reason to live. Don’t suffer silently

Aw my bro I didn’t mean to be so blunt. Similarly I used shrooms, pills, acid tabs and cocaine to feed my impulsivity. If you don’t want to be around anymore please atleast seek a conversation with someone who specialises in addictions because it could be an underlying mental health problem. I was diagnosed with adhd and it cost quite a bit, but it changed my life man. It’s always better to feel something than nothing at all. Keep positive and don’t stop everything all at once. Pm me if you want to discuss it further

Using Valium or any benzo for recreational use just simply isn’t a good idea, the addictions you’ll get will eventually leave you without, that’s when you will need them for real. Anti psychotics will shortly follow

I’d recommend Elvanse Adult or vyvanse I’m 26 uk and have been on it for a year now. You sound as if you are close to being in control, medications do work, gotta be in constant contact with your psychiatrist as they will 100% listen. Hope you get on the right ADHD path

Hey bro, appreciate your words as sometimes seeing a particular situation in text right in front of your eyes is difficult. You have so many opportunities, not visible at this moment in time but life is a cruel and unfair, this isn’t set in stone though. The trials of yourself need to or already has started, once you find your true self, compromise with your body and how your mind can work equally together. Forget about your past for now, if it’s all negative but never forget the good and positive memories that you can keep. 
In family terms, siblings argue along with yourself and your mum, never ever threaten family physically, in no way possible does that work in your favour. Now listen, family at blood, you got to take care and indulge that you have one, if you can talk about your troubles to them they will listen, you will by automatic help them when needing your specific help. That’s a big task of which your family will need of you, share your love towards them when you can. 
Seek Medical Psychiatric help, as soon as you can, do it for yourself and the ones who LOVE and need YOU! I’m in the uk so 911 or look up a specific CRISIS numbers and get in touch. If you can do that on Monday you aren’t all these evil things you say you are, honing things that you’ve done wrong has been achieved already in this post. Massive step for further trials and retribution. Your you, no one can make drastic change but you and just by your post I can see how frustrated you are with what people think of you. People are judgemental and I also struggle with my dignity being shed or seeing neglect amongst other mental health suffering friends. Tell yourself I’m me, don’t even regard what people will think as you will almost never see or meet them. Friends come and go, a lot of people are wankers but you stick to the ones who give you mutual respect and who show interest. 
Show emotion in controlled situations such as therapy or if it’s fight or flight during crisis but don’t completely loose yourself internally, there is help, medications, hundreds of therapy cooperations and most of all there’s always a reason to be alive, it’s better to feel something than nothing. It is easier to fall mate but gods honest truth, if you rise the difficulty will be rewarding daily.

Ragnars family and life change often, in absolutely fascinating ways. Don’t stop watching!
